text:
rachel.k: Postmortem follow-up: we need a public status blurb, a 72-hour customer-facing summary, and a clear policy for who receives the full RCA. Also want owners for remediation tickets and a plan to track recurring incident patterns.

tony: I can draft the public blurb. Keep it short + promise of more detail in 72h.

anya: I'll author the 72h customer summary skeleton (timeline, metrics, mitigations, recurrence notes). I'll include a short "what we're changing" section.

legal: We'll issue the redaction checklist. Anything with PII, customer IDs, or internal hostnames must be redacted. Full RCA distribution requires Legal sign-off and, for some customers, an NDA.

support-lead: I'll prepare the impacted-customer list and tag outreach owners; we should proactively notify Dedicated customers and any customers with confirmed failures.

ops-bot: Reminder: add action items to PM-900 and set due dates.

rachel.k: Let's put concrete action items here. React with :thumbsup: to accept.

``` 
AI-901: Tony      - Draft public status blurb by today 18:00 UTC and post to Statuspage draft.
AI-902: Anya      - Draft 72h customer summary skeleton (timeline, impact metrics, short recurrence analysis, proposed runbook changes) by +72h.
AI-903: Legal     - Provide redaction checklist and approval flow by +48h.
AI-904: Support   - Export impacted-customer list and tag outreach owners by today EOD.
AI-905: Ops Lead  - Create remediation tickets for recurrence fixes, assign owners, and link to PM-900 by next sprint planning.
```

support-lead: Accepting AI-904. I'll upload the CSV and tag owners in PM-900 by 16:00 UTC.

tony: Accepting AI-901. Draft blurb below: "We experienced intermittent API errors between 03:12 and 04:05 UTC due to an internal database failover. Some requests returned 5xx errors. Normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after rerouting traffic and completing failover. We apologize for the disruption; a detailed summary and next steps will be published within 72 hours."

anya: That reads fine. For the 72h summary I'll include: 1) timeline with minute-level events, 2) measured impact (requests attempted, error rate delta), 3) mitigation steps taken, 4) recurrence analysis (recent failovers, traffic patterns), and 5) immediate short-term mitigations + items we plan to put into the ops backlog.

legal: For the 72h summary, we recommend excluding raw logs, internal hostnames/IPs, and request IDs tied to customers. Provide aggregated metrics and a redacted timeline. If a customer asks for the full RCA, route the request through Support -> Legal for NDA assessment.

rachel.k: Decision check: 72h summary contains high-level runbook notes (what we did) but not command output or hostnames. Full RCA (deep technical steps, playbook diffs, config snippets) will be shared only on request and after Legal sign-off / NDA where required. Agree?

anya: Agreed. I'll make a clear "What is included" section in the 72h doc so customers know what to expect.

support-lead: Question: do we proactively send the 72h summary to Dedicated customers or wait until outreach owners confirm impact?

tony: Proactively send to Dedicated customers and any on the impacted list. Support can follow up for those who want the full RCA.

ops-bot: Note: recurring-incident flag added to PM-900. Please link recurrence analysis artifacts.

rachel.k: Ops lead (cc @ops-bot) please ensure remediation tickets include recurrence tracking tags and an owner who will be responsible for closure verification.

ops-bot: Ops actions recommended: add tags "recurrence", "postmortem-action", and set a 30-day follow-up check.

anya: I'll drop the 72h skeleton into PM-900 in the next 12 hours. It will include a short "recurrence & next steps" block with two proposed runbook tweaks: 1) circuit-breaker backoff tuning; 2) add post-failover health checks and alert escalation.

legal: I'll draft the redaction checklist and an NDA template note for customers requesting full RCA. Expect it in PM-900 by EOD tomorrow.

support-lead: Uploaded impacted customer list and assigned outreach owners. Marking AI-904 done.

tony: Posted the status blurb to Statuspage draft and pinged @rachel.k for approval.

rachel.k: Approving public blurb. @legal please confirm the blurb wording is OK for public consumption.

legal: Blurb is fine. Confirmed: no operational details leaked.

rachel.k: Closing loop on owners: Tony (AI-901) posted blurb, Anya (AI-902) to publish 72h doc, Legal (AI-903) will attach redaction checklist, Support (AI-904) completed impacted list, Ops Lead (AI-905) to create and track remediation tickets. Setting a manual reminder to check PM-900 in 48 hours for status.

anya: Uploaded 72h skeleton to PM-900: includes timeline, impact metrics, recurrence analysis, and the two proposed runbook fixes. I'll add the "what's in/out" redaction section before publishing.

ops-bot: AI-901..AI-905 added to PM-900 with due dates. Follow-up reminder set for 48h.

support-lead: Starting outreach to Dedicated customers now; we'll attach the 72h summary when complete.

rachel.k: If any owner needs to shift ETA, call it out in this thread so we can reassign quickly. Thanks everyone.

tony: :thumbsup:

anya: :rocket:
